other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: Applying a scaler or normalizer to the entire training set before splitting it into cross-validation folds leaks distribution statistics (mean/variance) from the validation folds into the training folds, leading to overly optimistic CV scores.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound LightGBM training pipeline with cross-validation and early stopping. However, it completely skips data cleaning and feature engineering, relies on only a single evaluation metric, and introduces data leakage during cross-validation by fitting the scaler before the CV splits.
